title: docs.aws.amazon.com/us_en/glue/latest/dg/connecting-to-salesforce-commerce-cloud.md
snippet:
The B2C Commerce API is a collection of RESTful APIs for interacting with B2C Commerce instances. It goes by a few different names: Salesforce Commerce API, the acronym SCAPI, or just Commerce API.
The API enables developers to build a wide range of applications: from full storefronts to custom merchant tools to augment Business Manager. For all B2C Commerce customers, the API is available at no extra cost.

title: Commerce Cloud
snippet:
Salesforce Commerce Cloud offers distinct solutions for B2B/D2C (business-to-business and direct-to-consumer) and B2C (business-to-consumer) commerce. B2B and D2C Commerce solutions focus on complex order and account management, advanced personalization, and enterprise integration. B2C Commerce emphasizes high-volume transactions, customer engagement, seamless mobile-optimized checkout, and real-time inventory management.

### B2C Commerce API (SCAPI)
Use a headless API to build custom apps. B2C Commerce API is also known as Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI). Applies to: Composable, hybrid, and custom.

### Open Commerce API (OCAPI)
Access B2C Commerce data (such as product and shopper data) and functionality (such as baskets and orders) through secure and well-defined API methods. Applies to: Composable, SFRA, hybrid, and custom.

title: About | B2C Commerce API

title: Salesforce Developers
snippet: B2C Commerce has two REST API products: the [Open Commerce API (OCAPI)](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/b2c-commerce/references) and the [B2C Commerce API, also known as Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI)](https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/commerce/commerce-api/guide). OCAPI has been in the platform since 2014 and is used by many customers on the B2C Commerce platform.
